name: io.github.zekebuilds-lab/mcp-identity
description: DoI score lookup, vouch event builder, and offline schnorr verify for AI agents.

environmentVariables.description: PowForge Depth-of-Identity oracle base URL. Defaults to public production endpoint when running via npx; override for self-hosted or local dev.
environmentVariables.name: ORACLE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Schnorr pubkey of the DoI oracle, used for offline envelope verification. Defaults to the production PowForge oracle pubkey; override only if pointing at a self-hosted oracle.
environmentVariables.name: ORACLE_PUBKEY
